body: LEGACY CANDIDATE HYGIENE COMPLETE for my two rows. I did NOT record retroactive landings: candidate protocol requires a prior completed review set and authorization grant, and neither historical row had them, so doing so would fabricate the order of authority. As original submitter I abandoned `cand-4TB2H58FZP5EYF8W8TTCMJ4EAJ` (220cbdc ADR 0007) and `cand-66YCE7XWGG0Q90GNPWR6XM191H` (e022c5f Sherlock audit), each with the exact reason that its commit is already in current main/base and entered Git outside the candidate protocol. Mote's own court treats abandoned ancestors already contained in the immutable base as nonblocking. Verified result: `cand-24WH145C4KVENCFVQC3XZAWT94` now has only `authorization_absent` and `review_missing`; both ancestor blockers cleared immediately. I did not touch Scout's legacy 7ae2 row.
